text.headline: Timeline of Andorra
text.text: Major events in the history of Andorra.

events.headline: Foundation of Andorra
events.text: According to legend, Andorra was founded by Charlemagne as a buffer state against Muslim invasions. The region became a refuge for the local population seeking protection.

events.headline: First Documented Reference
events.text: The first written reference to Andorra appears in a document from the year 988, which mentions the region as a part of the Catalan counties.

events.headline: Establishment of Co-Principality
events.text: The co-principality of Andorra was established, with the Count of Foix and the Bishop of Urgell sharing power. This unique political arrangement continues to this day.

events.headline: First Andorran Constitution
events.text: The first constitution of Andorra was established, outlining the rights and responsibilities of its citizens and the governing bodies.

events.headline: Recognition by the Spanish Crown
events.text: The Spanish Crown officially recognized the co-princes of Andorra, solidifying its status as a principality under dual sovereignty.

events.headline: Andorran Flag Established
events.text: The flag of Andorra was officially adopted, featuring the national coat of arms and representing the country's unique heritage.

events.headline: French Revolution Impact
events.text: The French Revolution had a significant impact on Andorra, leading to changes in governance and the relationship with France.

events.headline: Modernization of Andorra
events.text: Andorra began to modernize its economy and infrastructure, moving away from traditional agricultural practices.

events.headline: Constitution of 1933
events.text: A new constitution was adopted, establishing a parliamentary system and granting civil rights to Andorran citizens.

events.headline: New Constitution Adopted
events.text: A new constitution was adopted, replacing the previous one from 1933 and further defining the political structure of Andorra.

events.headline: Current Constitution Enacted
events.text: The current constitution of Andorra was enacted, establishing a parliamentary democracy and reaffirming the co-principality.

events.headline: Andorra Joins the UN
events.text: Andorra became a member of the United Nations, marking a significant step in its international recognition and diplomatic relations.

events.headline: Andorra Signs Tax Agreement with Spain
events.text: Andorra signed a tax agreement with Spain, aimed at increasing transparency and cooperation in financial matters.

events.headline: Andorra's First International Agreement
events.text: Andorra signed its first international agreement with the European Union, paving the way for future cooperation and economic integration.

events.headline: Andorra's Economic Reforms
events.text: The government of Andorra implemented significant economic reforms to diversify its economy and reduce reliance on tourism.

events.headline: COVID-19 Pandemic Response
events.text: Andorra faced challenges during the COVID-19 pandemic, implementing measures to protect public health and support the economy.

events.headline: Vaccination Rollout
events.text: Andorra began its vaccination rollout against COVID-19, aiming to achieve herd immunity and return to normalcy.

events.headline: Andorra's Continued Development
events.text: Andorra continues to develop its economy and strengthen its international relations, focusing on sustainability and innovation.
